changelog:
- Initial release of finance-memory skill.
- Enables agents to remember, store, and recall finance and budget data using BlueColumn persistent memory.
- Supports storing budget notes, quick notes with tags, and querying past financial context.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*) for access.
- Detailed setup and API usage instructions provided in the documentation.
summary: Give AI agents Remember finances and budgets. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent tracks budgets and financial context; when the user wants to store, recall, or search finance memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
